recipes.name: Vegan Caesar Dressing
instructions: Add all of the ingredients to a blender.
Blend until smooth, then enjoy with your favourite salad!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † If unable to soak overnight, simply cover with boiling water and let sit for at least 15 minutes to soften.
Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 4 days. The sauce thickens when stored in the fridge. Simply add more water for a thinner consistency.
